summary: Barbara A. Drummond is an Alabama legislative candidate who ran in the 2014 House District 103 election, recording approximately +29.9 OOF CMO and remaining a high performer across audited precinct-allocation scenarios with estimates ranging from +12.9 to +29.9. She holds a Shor-McCarty score of -0.610, placing her on the progressive side of Alabama's Democratic House caucus at entry into office in 2014. Her later record includes support for Medicaid expansion and opposition to permitless carry gun-storage legislation, public education funding, and equity-focused neighborhood investment. Campaign-visible signals recovered include an alignment with labor/public-education based on records from the Alabama Education Association shortly before her general election.
